vehicle had "" wrecked out "" at the south bound 35e 381 milford exit. as i arrived on scene i noticed that there were two other vehicles on the scene. one was a 2004 silver cadillac ( unit2 ) facing (unit #1 was off of the roadway) i did not observe any tire marks or skid marks from unit #1. unit #1 came to rest shortly after the area of impact, which indicated excessive speed was not a factor. the other pedestrian wrote a statement which was attached to this report. no other witnesses stopped at the crash scene.
